summary: The register holds 39 questions, of which 15 are candidates, 23 are parked after gate failure or adversarial check and 1 is merged. The citation benchmark is written. The baseline report and the guideline extracts are still outstanding, and the appraisal backlog stands at about 6,100 records after today's batch. The register was not re-scored this month and no new ideas were added, because no new Tier A record changed the evidence base of a top-ten question; the adversarial reports from the baseline stand.

domain_narratives.D1: Coronary intervention: PubMed monthly counts for the domain query totalled 6,400 entries in the 12 months to September 2026, against 5,643 in the preceding 12 months, a change of +13%. Counts are by entry date and include all designs, so the rise partly reflects overall growth in indexing and the broadened queries of version 2. The appraised subset is still a minority of the store, so topic-level movement is described in the landscape files rather than here.

validation: Seed recall was 100% in all nine domains at the maintenance run of 3 November 2026. Core-journal completeness was 0.868 (10 of 76 indexed in-scope Crossref items missing), below the 98% target; the cause has not yet been traced and no query change was made. The precision sample was not repeated this month.
